correctness.rationale: The two signed cube strata reproduce the enriched order/chain definitions. The order hull is y_j<=1 and 2|x_i|-y_j<=1, so all q+2pq facet distances and unique golden-ratio incenter follow by matching unit and sqrt5 normals; beta integration gives volume, pyramid formula S/V=n/r. Symmetry of smallest enclosing ball forces center (0,t 1_q), and minimizing max{q(1+t)^2,p+q(1-t)^2} gives t=min(p/(4q),1), all contacts and 4:1 equality threshold. Support functions max(A,B+T) and max(A,B) yield exact width identity. Joint CLT of (sum|H|,sum H), mean subtraction and uniform integrability yield stated Gaussian critical law, including normalized balance and nonbalance. Independent six parameter p,q vertex and support checks plus 60 directions matched. Chain radius sqrt(max(p,q)) and inradius 1/sqrt2 are known in greater generality and not counted as new.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks corroborate the proven ranges but do not substitute for all-parameter argument.
